blocking_findings.finding: Plan source v1 and compiler stop at WPRA; no canonical finalization producer exists for manifest, execution-entry rehearsal, eligibility, adoption, review, request or response bindings.
The canonical execution-entry rehearsal schema requires joined_driver_digest, but its fixture producer omits it; 14 closure tests error during setup while 6 teardown tests pass.

Governance preparation runs a real coordinator, but Invoke closeout and Task Session terminal currently parse schemas rather than execute production transformations; several other stages remain fixture-adapted.
Preacceptance emits request v2/response v1 while accepted-stream consumes response v2 and request v3 exists without one selected canonical end-to-end producer route.
Closure, adoption, review and eligibility IDs are free nonempty strings; exact refs catch byte drift but do not prevent internally consistent new graphs retaining stale semantic IDs.
